# THE GUIDE (guide)

A dark long-form article page — numbered sections, callouts, code blocks and tables in a narrow reading column.

- **Technique:** LONG-FORM ARTICLE
- **Tags:** article, documentation, long-form, blog, dark, readable
- **Best for:** docs; case studies; blog posts
- **Fonts:** Fraunces, Inter, JetBrains Mono
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,400;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,300;1,9..144,400&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #08080d · #e8c168 · #7ce7d8
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/guide/` (Template.astro, content.ts, meta.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <b>/<em>/<code>/<a>/<br> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** One block of article body, rendered in order inside a section. */
export type Block =
  /** Body paragraph. */
  | { type: 'paragraph'; textHtml: string }
  /** Gold-ruled aside. */
  | { type: 'callout'; textHtml: string }
  /** Bulleted (default) or numbered list. */
  | { type: 'list'; ordered?: boolean; itemsHtml: string[] }
  /** Preformatted block; keep line breaks, wrap highlights in `<b>`. */
  | { type: 'code'; codeHtml: string }
  /** Two-or-more column table; the first column is set in gold monospace. */
  | { type: 'table'; head: string[]; rowsHtml: string[][] };

export interface Section {
  /** Mono eyebrow above the heading, e.g. "01 · THE BRIEF". */
  num: string;
  title: string;
  blocks: Block[];
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark in the nav; links to `wordmarkHref`. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  wordmarkHref: string;
  /** Link on the right of the nav. */
  back: Link;
  hero: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    ledeHtml: string;
  };
  sections: Section[];
  /** Closing call-to-action card. */
  cta: { title: string; body: string; button: Link };
  footerHtml: string;
}
```

## Use it
- Full site: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs template guide --out <dir>`
- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style guide --out <dir>`
- Read `src/templates/guide/style.css` and `Template.astro` (from the plugin root) for exact component styling and markup.
